dispositions.substance: one document.units action under options-product opens the single Document Units dialog; the two permanent unit status segments are presentation-only and invoke that action on click; no second editing authority

the New document units panel stores defaults only for future blank documents; changing them never alters the current UnitState, XML, undo stack or saved/dirty state; applied only through the C6 new-document lifecycle
a recognized geocedgUnits element outside the document construction fails closed; in a macro context it stays ignored with a text diagnostic; misplaced metadata is never reinterpreted

localized en/es diagnostics for unsupported newer version, malformed element, invalid or missing usm factor, duplicate element, misplaced element; failed File > Open leaves the previous live document and its saved, undo and file state unchanged

Construction.isStarted() keeps its meaning; a narrow shared seam hasSaveRelevantContent() = constructionStarted OR persistentDocumentMetadataPresent (UnitState != EMPTY for D1); App.isSaved() uses it; presentation/session state never save-relevant; stop if impossible without material widening

keys geocedg.units.new-document-construction.v1 (unspecified, mm, cm, m) and geocedg.units.new-document-presentation.v1 (none, mm, cm, m); never usm; invalid stored values unset and not rewritten by reading

Insert File carries the inserted document's provenance; different physical meanings show the same non-blocking notice; never rescale, convert or modify target units; a later Ctrl+V keeps that provenance until the buffer is replaced or cleared

persisted grammar and dialog input use the D0 section 8.4 grammar with '.'; a decimal comma is rejected with a localized hint, never converted; no grouping separators; canonical writer locale-independent

transient paste-notice status segment; no serialization, undo, geometry, sound or modal dialog; names both units; clears after about 10 s, on the next paste or document transition; EDT-safe; lifecycle testable without real sleeps; distinct from the permanent segments
no immediate older-reader warning; limitation recorded in candidate evidence and smoke checklist; user guide owned by G

shared reader, writer, validation and fail-closed rules apply to the Classic diagnostic app; no Classic unit UI or geometry behavior; EMPTY documents byte-identical; valid unit documents read and preserved; malformed/future fail closed; forbidden only Classic-specific unit UI, geometry semantics, orchestration or feature expansion; Web: no new claim, shared code within its build constraints, no Web-specific unit UI; stop on a Web semantic fork or material frontend broadening

binary64CanonicalWriter: shared deterministic writer per C5; never Double.toString, String.valueOf(double), implicit double concatenation or locale-sensitive formatters for usmMetersPerUnit
